about.text: Major League Response provides 24/7 water damage mitigation, mold remediation, fire and smoke damage cleanup, and contents pack-out and pack-back services for residential and commercial properties throughout Los Angeles and surrounding Southern California communities. Our IICRC-certified team focuses on fast response, professional documentation, clear communication, and quality service from the initial inspection through completion.

items.question: Do you provide 24/7 emergency water damage response?
items.answer: Yes. Major League Response provides 24/7 emergency water damage response throughout Los Angeles and surrounding service areas. We respond as quickly as possible to begin water extraction, moisture assessment, and structural drying when needed.

items.question: Do you work with insurance companies for water, mold, and fire damage claims?
items.answer: Yes. When insurance is involved, we can document the damage, prepare detailed estimates, provide photos and supporting documentation, and communicate with your insurance carrier regarding our scope of work. Coverage and claim decisions are determined by your insurance company and policy.

items.question: How do you handle professional mold remediation?
items.answer: Our mold remediation process may include containment, HEPA air filtration, removal of affected materials, and detailed cleaning based on the conditions and scope of work. When required, post-remediation clearance testing can be performed by an independent third party.

items.name: Sarah T., Irvine
items.quote: They arrived within 45 minutes of my frantic call. A pipe burst in the kitchen and flooded into the living room, but their crew extracted the water and set up drying equipment so fast that our hardwood floors were saved. Highly recommend their professionalism.

items.name: Mark D., Santa Clarita
items.quote: Dealt with a difficult mold issue in our attic that another company failed to fully clear. Major League Response handled the abatement clean and quick, and their communication throughout the insurance process was phenomenal.

items.name: Jessica L., Orange County
items.quote: After a small kitchen fire, the smoke damage was overwhelming. The team cleaned, deodorized, and completely rebuilt the damaged cabinets. It looks better now than it did before the incident.
